Device: the town's rulebook — a town clerk's typewriter types ordinance headings and each is stamped PREEMPTED (W. Va. Code §5B-2-21b, from HB 2014); the corkboard behind carries the recorded line and the two denials; the last sheet is the bill itself, ending DRAFTED BY: ____.
argument: West Virginia's HB 2014 stops towns from applying their own noise, lighting, viewshed and zoning rules to certified data centers; a Fundamental Data engineer was recorded saying 'we're the guys that wrote the bill', which the company and the governor's office deny.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word

captions.source: General: West Virginia municipalities adopt ordinances (noise, lighting, zoning). The paper in the typewriter is a blank generic ordinance, 'TOWN OF ____', not a document of Davis: Davis passed a resolution, not an ordinance.

captions.source: HB 2014 (2025), Power Generation and Consumption Act, signed 30 Apr 2025 (governor's release; WV MetroNews 1 May 2025); §5B-2-21b: certified microgrid districts and certified high impact data centers 'may not be subject to … County or municipal zoning, horticultural, noise, viewshed, lighting, development, or land use ordinances' (WVCBP, datacenterdata.com). post.en: West Virginia's HB 2014 stops towns from applying their own noise, lighting and zoning rules to certified data centers. A Fundamental Data engineer was recorded saying "we're the guys that wrote the bill." The company and the governor's office deny it. So who wrote the rules?
